settings.title: Why We Never Use Chemical Machines or Acid Washes.

settings.editor: Traditional chemical polymer recycling washes materials in caustic acids and organic solvents, introducing hazardous liquid effluent and degrading the polymer chain length. At Montreal Polymers, we refuse toxic shortcuts. Our facility uses multi-stage high-torque shredding, progressive heavy granulators, and multi-deck aspirators to mechanically clean, separate, and regrind industrial plastics — producing virgin-grade performance with zero toxic footprint.

settings.description_text: Preserves melt flow index (MFI), tensile strength, and impact resistance for flawless remolding.
No chemical sludge or caustic rinse solutions discharged into Montreal waterways.
Compliant with environmental sustainability audits and strict manufacturer QA tolerances.

settings.title: Quebec's Most Dedicated Rigid PVC Recovery Stream

settings.editor: PVC cannot tolerate contamination from polyolefins like PE or PP. Montreal Polymers operates an isolated, dedicated rigid PVC processing line with dedicated heavy shredders, granulators, and magnetic/optical separation units to ensure zero cross-contamination.
